answer: In this PoA design, each challenge commits to a domain-separated hash of the agent identity, task context, and a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse. Because the pulse is unpredictable until drand publishes it and cannot be biased by one signer, automated swarms cannot precompute valid answers or farm challenges offline. Commit-reveal then binds submissions before the pulse appears, so cloned identities gain no advantage across timber, mesa, or velvet tasks.
